queue.title: Add CI/CD pipeline with GitHub Actions
queue.description: No continuous integration exists. Changes are not automatically tested before merge.
queue.patch:
# Create .github/workflows/ci.yml:

name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    
    strategy:
      matrix:
        node-version: [18.x, 20.x, 22.x]
    
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    
    - name: Setup Node.js ${{ matrix.node-version }}
      uses: actions/setup-node@v4
      with:
        node-version: ${{ matrix.node-version }}
    
    - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v2
      with:
        version: 8
    
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
    
    - name: Run linter
      run: pnpm lint
    
    - name: Run type check
      run: pnpm run build
    
    - name: Run tests
      run: pnpm test
    
    - name: Upload coverage
      uses: codecov/codecov-action@v3
      if: matrix.node-version == '20.x'
      with:
        files: ./coverage/coverage-final.json

  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: test
    
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    
    - name: Setup Node.js
      uses: actions/setup-node@v4
      with:
        node-version: '20.x'
    
    - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v2
      with:
        version: 8
    
    - name: Install and build
      run: |
        pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
        pnpm run build
    
    - name: Upload artifacts
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v3
      with:
        name: build
        path: build/
tests: Push to branch and verify CI runs
Create PR and verify checks pass
Break tests and verify CI fails
acceptance: CI runs on every push and PR
Tests run on multiple Node versions
